purpose: Test whether factoring a cheap seam-aware constitutive mobility scale out of the two-dimensional steady face mobility removes the remaining path-crossing interpolation tail while retaining bounded O(1) runtime and the existing memory ceiling.

candidate.axis: same piecewise-uniform seam-aligned R1 axis with exact nodes at h=-4 and -40 cm
candidate.two_dimensional_storage: float32 log residual r = log(M_exact / M_phi)
candidate.one_dimensional_storage: float64 Phi(h) at the same 241 axis nodes
candidate.phi_definition: Phi(h) = integral from -10000 cm to h of K(xi) dxi
candidate.reference_mobility: M_phi(ha,hb) = [Phi(hb)-Phi(ha)]/(hb-ha), with equal/near-equal head limit K((ha+hb)/2)
candidate.runtime_phi_lookup: O(1) linear interpolation in the same piecewise u coordinate

probes: Reuse the exact C2B characterization probes including explicit -40 and -4 cm join probes. These remain characterization probes and are not a future holdout.
hard_rules: Do not change the H_ENPR/SVG2006 physical closure.
Do not increase the 2D table above N241 in this gate.
Do not relax any C1R face-flux threshold.
The runtime candidate must use the stored 1D Phi table, not on-the-fly quadrature.
Do not add runtime root finding or nonlinear iteration.
Keep the failed uniform and seam-only evidence unchanged.
If R2 passes characterization, freeze a separate fresh unseen face-flux holdout before qualification.
If R2 fails broadly, do not silently densify; characterize the residual topology before another representation change.
scope_guard: Representation characterization only. No transient, groundwater, production or empirical hydraulic-validation claim.
